Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Weaver
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 193 as introduced proposes an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama 1901 which, if ratified, would authorize the Shelby County Commission and municipalities within the county to authorize and regulate the use of low-speed vehicles, including golf carts, on certain public roads.
This bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $1,500 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Bedsole
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/16/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 253 as amended and reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund (ETF) by an estimated $3.6 million annually by allowing certain qualified firefighter or rescue squad members to claim an annual income tax credit of either $300 or $600, dependent upon the certification or license held by the firefighter or rescue squad member, and contingent upon the annual certification of meeting certain training requirements.
Pursuant to the provisions of the ETF Rolling Reserve Act contained in Section 29-9-3(b)(3), Code of Alabama 1975, the provisions of this bill will reduce the ETF fiscal year appropriation cap for fiscal year 2023 by $3.6 million.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
